clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for broken brick (burnt clay) fine aggregate for use in lime mortar.

clauses.title: General Quality
clauses.text: 2. General Quality — Shall be prepared from broken/ solid bricks conforming to class designation 50 and above of IS 1077:1992*. It shall be free from underburnt clay particles, soluble salts and adherent coating of soil or silt.

clauses.title: Physical Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Physical Requirements IS Sieve Percent Passing(By Mass) 4.75 mm 100 2.36 mm 90-100 1.18 mm 70-100 600 µm 40-100 300 µm 5-70 150 µm 0-15 75 µm Nil * Common burnt clay building bricks (fifth revision). Note —   For methods of tests, refer to relevant parts of   IS 2386: Method of test for aggregates for concrete, and IS 3068:1986 Broken brick (burnt clay) coarse aggregate for use in lime concret (second revision). For  detailed information, refer to IS 3182:1986 Specification for broken brick (burnt clay) fine aggregate for use in lime mortar (second revision). SUMMARY OF IS 3182 : 1986 BROKEN BRICK (BURNT CLAY) FINE AGGREGATE FOR USE IN LIME MORTAR (Second  Revision)
